added: Device Sync now carries your own figures from the Glossary, your notes on built-in figures, the Custom Figures setting and your shorthands for your own figures, once every device connected to your store has this version of the app or a later one. Until then they stay on the device they were made on, and Device Sync names the device holding them back.

Add the `glossaryEntry` and `figureNote` sync record kinds, with `StoredUserGlossaryEntry`, `UserGlossaryRepository.writeFromSync` and `FigureNoteRepository.writeFromSync`. A glossary entry's kind and payload travel as stored text, so an entry a build cannot read is kept and republished unchanged; its `createdAt` travels unchanged.
`SyncCapabilityPolicy.build` gates both kinds on `glossary.v1` and advertises it.
